latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Effortless AI-driven video explainers from raw footage or slides.

- Instantly turn a 2-minute screen recording or slides into a narrated 1080p explainer video in 1–2 minutes.
- No manual editing — just upload your footage and describe what you want; AI handles the rest.
- Seamless setup with automatic cloud connection and free anonymous access (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Supports key workflows: quick edits, batch sessions, and iterative refinement with timeline state.
- Broad format support (video: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv; image/audio: jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, etc.).
- Built-in error handling and export management for a smooth user experience.
